title: A/P Unpaid Invoices: No. sorts by number value, and ties go by number
custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as a user with the "Admin" role, with {Location-A} as your current location.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • Vendor {Vendor-A} has overdue bills on today's date.
    For example: {Vendor-A} is ZZAUTOTEST S2-22 Fleet.
  • In {Vendor-A}'s group there are three open bills with the same due date, {Document-A}, {Document-B} and {Document-C}, whose numbers have different digit counts, so that in number order they read {Document-A}, {Document-B}, {Document-C} but in letter-by-letter order {Document-B}, {Document-C}, {Document-A}.
    For example: {Document-A} is S1-99, {Document-B} is S1-100 and {Document-C} is S1-101 (the app assigns the real numbers).
  • Starting screen: Reports > Finance > A/P Unpaid Invoices is open in a desktop browser window 1440 px wide, as opened from the Reports menu, with {Vendor-A}'s group expanded.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Click the "No." header.
  2. Click the "No." header again.
  3. Click the "Due Date" header.
  4. Read the order of {Document-A}, {Document-B} and {Document-C}, which share the same Due Date.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: rows inside each vendor group sort by No. as numbers, never letter by letter: {Document-A}, {Document-B}, {Document-C} in one direction (smallest number first) or the exact reverse. Note which.
  • Step 2: the exact reverse of step 1, still in number order.
  • Step 3: rows inside each vendor group sort by Due Date, oldest first.
  • Step 4: the three tie on Due Date, so they are ordered by number: {Document-A}, {Document-B}, {Document-C} (smallest number first).

Which direction the first click on No. gives is not stated in the PRD; it is asked in the question sheet (question 3), and whether ties reverse when a sort is reversed is question 4. The case checks number order both ways and the tie order on the first click only.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "A/R and A/P Report Sorting, Export and Location Filter", Confluence 947650561, version 5 (21 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 22 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11315, story SV-11532 (Story 2, Sort by clicking any column header)

  • S2-R4: “ID and No. sort by number value: S1-99 before S1-100 before S1-101. The same number-aware order breaks ties in every sort.”
  • S2-R1, A/P Detail and A/P Unpaid Invoices columns: “A/P Detail and A/P Unpaid Invoices: Date, Location (when shown), Transaction Type, No., Vendor Name, Due Date, Past Due, Amount, Open Balance.”
  • S2-R2: “The first click gives the useful order for the kind of data: text (names, Location, Transaction type) A to Z; money columns largest first; dates oldest first; Past Due largest first. The second click reverses it. The third click repeats the first; there is no unsorted state.”
